vson_p:
(scene / Composition
    :framedBy (cam / CameraView :angle eye_level :focalLength 50mm :framing medium_shot)
    :framedBy (sc / SceneContext :venue outdoor :atmosphere cold :timeOfDay day :weather cloudy)
    :viewedBy cam
    :rendersAs (vs / VisualStyle :aesthetic realistic :palette cool_tones :medium photography)
    :depicts (mountainRange / Aggregate :class "Mountain Range"
        :individuation Generic :animacy Inert :countability Collective
        :bbox2d "0.0,0.0,1.0,0.9"
        :hasPart (mountain1 / PhysicalObject :class Mountain
            :individuation Generic :animacy Inert :countability Count
            :bbox2d "0.0,0.0,0.6,0.8")
        :hasPart (mountain2 / PhysicalObject :class Mountain
            :individuation Generic :animacy Inert :countability Count
            :bbox2d "0.4,0.0,0.6,0.7")
        :hasQuality (q1 / Quality :dimension Material :value rock)
        :hasQuality (q2 / Quality :dimension Material :value snow))
    :depicts (snowyGround / Substance :class Snow
        :individuation Generic :animacy Inert :countability Mass
        :bbox2d "0.0,0.5,1.0,0.5")
    :depicts (group / Aggregate :class Group
        :individuation Generic :animacy Agentive :countability Collective
        :bbox2d "0.3,0.8,0.3,0.1"
        :hasPart (person1 / PhysicalObject :class Person
            :individuation Generic :animacy Agentive :countability Count
            :bbox2d "0.32,0.83,0.02,0.05")
        :hasPart (person2 / PhysicalObject :class Person
            :individuation Generic :animacy Agentive :countability Count
            :bbox2d "0.41,0.83,0.02,0.05")
        :hasPart (person3 / PhysicalObject :class Person
            :individuation Generic :animacy Agentive :countability Count
            :bbox2d "0.46,0.83,0.02,0.05")
        :hasPart (person4 / PhysicalObject :class Person
            :individuation Generic :animacy Agentive :countability Count
            :bbox2d "0.52,0.83,0.02,0.05"))
    :depicts (sf1 / SpatialFact
        :figure group :ground snowyGround
        :rcc EC :directional in_front_of :viewer cam)
    :depicts (sf2 / SpatialFact
        :figure mountainRange :ground snowyGround
        :rcc EC :directional behind :viewer cam)
    :depicts (sf3 / SpatialFact
        :figure mountainRange :ground group
        :rcc EC :directional behind :viewer cam))
